name: che-keychain
description: Trust-isolated macOS keychain credential prompt. Native NSAlert renders inside a signed binary's own process — caller (LLM / MCP / script) never sees the typed value. 0.3.0: set --from-clipboard (paste-free, dialog-confirmed) and --stdin (automation), every store read back and verified, exit codes 0/1/2/3/4, ownership-aware set/unset. Wrapper auto-downloads the signed CheKeychain binary from the PsychQuant/che-keychain GitHub Release to ~/bin/che-keychain so consumers find it via PATH.
